verdict.rationale: Hummingbird has its own background automation: marketing copy says it 'automates routine work' with 'customizable automation', and the help docs describe pending reviews that open automatically on a recurring cadence (typically 90 days). However, workflows appear to be configured by Hummingbird for the customer rather than built by users, and there is no documentation of a user-facing automation builder, triggers, or schedules. Missing for 10: self-service automation setup by the user, documented triggers/conditions/actions, user-defined recurring schedules, agent-run background automation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
Streamline your onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations using customizable automation
Hummingbird creates a "pending" review of the case that will automatically open when it's time to review the case again (typically 90 days).
We can easily configure your Hummingbird account with workflows that mirror your policies.
